senses.definition: Synonym of booty, goods seized from an enemy by violence, particularly (historical) during the sacking of a town in war or (video games) after successful combat.
examples: India went from being a world-famous exporter of finished cloth into an importer, went from having 27% of world trade to less than 2%. The loot from the sack of Constantinople included the head of John the Baptist.
